name: Green INC.
source:
This is a game about being fucked by Goblins.

Goblins want to rule the world but running it. Make deals with major towns to one day rule over it. Fuck allot of people along the way both literal and figuratively. 

[From [url=https://graybeast.itch.io/green-inc-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一款关于被哥布林操的游戏。

哥布林打算通过经营来统治世界。与各大城镇达成交易，为终有一天将世界收入囊中铺路。一路上，把许多人狠狠“干”一遍——无论是字面意义上，还是比喻意义上。

[摘自[url=https://graybeast.itch.io/green-inc-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
